⌈
The interface
ara::crypto::cryp::Crypto-
Provider::CreateKeyDecapsulatorPrivateCtx
shall return an instance of
ara::crypto::cryp::KeyDecapsulatorPrivateCtx
implementing the algo-
rithm specified by the provided parameter
ara::crypto::CryptoAlgId
. The in-
terface shall return
•
kUnknownIdentifier

ara::crypto::CryptoAlgId
is not
supported.
•
kInvalidArgument
, if the provided
ara::crypto::CryptoAlgId
is sup-
ported but does not refer to key decapsulation.
